'''Antilles''' was a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. Antilles earned the nickname "Sureshot" during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE" />
